changelog:
Version 0.0.2

- Raised minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement to 3.3.3 (was 3.3.1).
- Added mandatory CLI user-agent string: all commands must include `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-analyticdb-postgresql-supabase-ops`.
- Introduced required enable/disable workflow for AI-Mode before and after all CLI usage.
- Updated installation and pre-check instructions, including plugin update requirements.
- Clarified workflow and exit rules for AI-Mode and user-agent handling.
